read.thesis: Q3 2024 PPG: volumes softened on auto OEM downtime, but portfolio exits ($550m AR&C US/Canada at ~14x, $310m silicas) and $175m self-help savings are the change signals; no capacity cuts disclosed beyond exits.

triggers.label: AR&C US/Canada sold for $550m
triggers.quote: we have reached a definitive agreement to sell 100% of this business for a transaction value of $550 million

triggers.label: Restructuring: $175m savings, $250m charge
triggers.quote: This program will deliver approximately $175 million once fully implemented, including savings of $60 million in 2025.

triggers.label: Auto OEM downtime hit volumes
triggers.quote: the automotive OEM industry, particularly in the US and Europe, has taken unscheduled prolonged downtime that was not considered in our July financial guidance

triggers.label: Index-linked auto pricing still falling
triggers.quote: the vast majority of the negative price you see is index contracts. And those are on time lags of anywhere from 6 to 12 months

guidance.quote: This program will deliver approximately $175 million once fully implemented, including savings of $60 million in 2025.
We're projecting for fourth quarter high single-digit growth and there could be upside for that.
we expect this will continue in the fourth quarter

red_flags.label: Auto OEM downtime not in guidance
red_flags.quote: has taken unscheduled prolonged downtime that was not considered in our July financial guidance

evasions.quote: We're not going to give our '25 guidance.
